add_definitions(
    -DWINE_REGISTER_DLL)

generate_idl_iids(qmgrprxy.idl)
spec2def(qmgrprxy.dll qmgrprxy.spec)
add_rpcproxy_files(qmgrprxy.idl)

add_idl_reg_objects(qmgrprxy registry qmgrprxy.idl)

# qmgrprxy.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/qmgrprxy-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(qmgrprxy_shims OBJECT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qmgrprxy_i.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qmgrprxy_p.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proxy.dlldata.c)
target_link_libraries(qmgrprxy_shims PRIVATE wine librpcrt4 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(qmgrprxy_shims)
set(QMGRPRXY_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/qmgrprxy/qmgrprxy_r.o)
add_cargo_module(qmgrprxy qmgrprxy-cargo qmgrprxy.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS qmgrprxy_shims qmgrprxy_r ${QMGRPRXY_REUSED} psdk)
